lines.text: Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles, received the mystery by revelation.
The mystery was not made known in other generations, but the Spirit has now revealed it to apostles and prophets.
Through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and Paul became its servant by the gift of God's law.
Paul, least of all saints, was given grace to preach Christ's riches so the church shows God's wisdom to kings.

wrong_details.true: rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms

lines.text: In Christ we may enter God's presence with boldness, and Paul asks believers not to be discouraged by his sufferings.
